notes: Reusable unique signature effects. Names and text are placeholders marked [Koto] for a later pass. Numbers on each unique are Epic-base values; ABEffects scales them by rarity and optional enchant milestones.

types.name: [Koto] Ember Burst
types.text: [Koto] {chance}% chance on hit to burst for {damage} {element} damage in a small ring.

types.name: [Koto] Death Bloom
types.text: [Koto] On kill, the target explodes for {damage} {element} damage.

types.name: [Koto] Last Watch
types.text: [Koto] When life falls below {hpPct}%, gain a {absorb} point shield. {cooldown}s cooldown.

types.name: [Koto] Counting Peal
types.text: [Koto] Every {every}th hit chains {damage} {element} damage to a nearby foe.

types.name: [Koto] Still Air
types.text: [Koto] Attackers are chilled for {duration}s when they strike you.

types.name: [Koto] Hooked Reply
types.text: [Koto] When hit, deal {damage} {element} damage to the attacker and nearby foes.

types.name: [Koto] Quick Step
types.text: [Koto] Kills grant {move}% move speed and {ias}% attack speed for {duration}s.

types.name: [Koto] Kindled Crit
types.text: [Koto] Critical hits ignite the target for {damage} fire damage.

types.name: [Koto] Marked Thorn
types.text: [Koto] Hits apply a brand. At {stacks} stacks the mark bursts for {damage} {element} damage.

types.name: [Koto] Last Cut
types.text: [Koto] Hits against foes below {hpPct}% life deal {damage} bonus {element} damage.

types.name: [Koto] Soft Ward
types.text: [Koto] Hits grant a {absorb} point ward, up to {absorbMax}.
